text:
Il documento non può rispondere a domande su:
1. **Date di scadenza specifiche**: per la pratica P01-006 (Riga 7), la scadenza è indicata come "da definire".
2. **Costi reali o finali**: gli importi sono esplicitamente definiti "preventivi, non consuntivi" (Riga 11), quindi non è possibile conoscere il budget effettivo speso.
3. **Stato attuale dei disegni**: la revisione dipende dalla disponibilità del disegno aggiornato, ma il documento non indica se tale disegno sia già disponibile o meno.

Dati mancanti necessari:
- Data precisa per P01-006.
- Consuntivi di spesa per tutte le pratiche.
- Stato di avanzamento o disponibilità dei disegni tecnici aggiornati.<|im_end|>

State which questions cannot be answered from the document and what data would be needed.

Document (fictional data):
Line 1. Bruno, responsible for the building services department, reports case P01-000, status approved, budget 9267 euros, deadline 2026-11-02. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 2. Carla, responsible for the structures department, reports case P01-001, status suspended, budget 7607 euros, deadline 2026-11-03. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 3. Diego, responsible for the construction department, reports case P01-002, status under review, budget 7686 euros, deadline 2026-11-04. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 4. Elena, responsible for the building services department, reports case P01-003, status approved, budget 4655 euros, deadline 2026-11-05. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 5. Fabio, responsible for the structures department, reports case P01-004, status approved, budget 8622 euros, deadline 2026-11-06. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 6. Giulia, responsible for the construction department, reports case P01-005, status suspended, budget 1220 euros, deadline 2026-11-07. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 7. Irene, responsible for the building services department, reports case P01-006, status under review, budget 1294 euros, deadline to be defined. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 8. Luca, responsible for the structures department, reports case P01-007, status approved, budget 3055 euros, deadline 2026-11-09. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 9. Marta, responsible for the construction department, reports case P01-008, status approved, budget 8006 euros, deadline 2026-11-10. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 10. Nadia, responsible for the building services department, reports case P01-009, status suspended, budget 3274 euros, deadline 2026-11-11. The review depends on the availability of the updated drawing.
Line 11. The proposal to bring all deadlines forward has not been approved. The stated amounts are estimates, not actual costs.

Keep the answer concise: at most about 120 words, or the requested code or data. Do not include internal reasoning.

The document cannot answer questions about:
1. **Specific due dates**: For case P01-006 (Line 7), the due date is indicated as "to be determined".
2. **Actual or final costs**: the amounts are explicitly defined as "estimated, not actual" (Line 11), so it is not possible to know the actual budget spent.
3. **Current status of drawings**: The revision depends on the availability of the updated drawing, but the document does not indicate whether this drawing is already available or not.

Missing data needed:
- Precise date for P01-006.
- Expenditure balance sheets for all practices.
- State of progress or availability of updated technical drawings.<|im_end|>
